description: The file contains the main activity class `OBJViewer` and a custom view class `OBJView` for rendering 3D object models using OpenGL ES. It manages loading, displaying, and animation of 3D objects in an Android app, handling user input, rendering setup, and object management.

classes.name: OBJView
classes.description: Custom Android View for rendering and interacting with 3D objects using OpenGL ES.

classes.name: OBJViewer
classes.description: Main activity class that manages loading 3D object files and launching the custom view for display.

methods.name: OBJView.reset
methods.description: Resets rotation, tilt, and scale parameters to initial state.

methods.name: OBJView.onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key events to control object rotation, tilt, and switching objects.

methods.name: OBJView.init
methods.description: Initializes OpenGL state and lighting settings.

methods.name: OBJViewer.getObject
methods.description: Returns the current 3D object being displayed.

methods.name: OBJViewer.nextObject
methods.description: Loads the next object in the predefined list of object files.

methods.name: OBJViewer.onCreate
methods.description: Activity lifecycle method that sets up the view and loads the initial 3D object.
